priorities.name: whole_scene_severe_damage_recognition
priorities.problem: Large persistent visible damage produced zero candidate findings.
priorities.goal: Detect major structural, ceiling, wall, surface, debris, and severe-deterioration conditions without requiring exact cause classification.

priorities.name: temporal_transient_condition_analysis
priorities.problem: Independent sparse stills do not adequately represent dripping water or electrical flicker.
priorities.goal: Analyze short same-region frame sequences for motion, dripping, and repeated brightness change.

priorities.name: fixture_condition_specialist
priorities.problem: Persistent abnormal fixture evidence across five frames produced zero candidate findings.
priorities.goal: Recognize deformation, obstruction, broken material, foreign material, and abnormal fixture geometry.

priorities.name: cross_keyframe_persistence_research
priorities.problem: The false positive had one supporting keyframe while the true positive had repeated support.
priorities.goal: Test persistence as a false-positive-control signal without suppressing genuine singleton defects.
